description:
Take that ride off-road with the Tread Pro Freestyle Dirt Scooter. Built for riding dirt jumps, flow trails, and gravel paths, the Tread Pro features a 23 x 5" T2 aluminum alloy deck and chromoly steel handlebar for maximum durability. The quadruple anodized clamp collar and threadless headset offer precise, crisp steering, while the steel foot brake delivers controlled stopping power. Plus, large 200 mm air-filled alloy core wheels and ABEC-9 bearings provide a smooth, stable ride. Are you ready to ride off-road? The Tread Pro is waiting.
Freestyle scooter built for riding on dirt and gravel. Durable, extended alloy deck supports riders ages 8 and up, with a 220 lbs. maximum weight limit.
Quadruple anodized clamp collar and threadless headset offer precise, crisp steering.
24-inch wide chromoly steel handlebar with 165 mm rubber grips provide durability and comfort.
Steel foot brake delivers controlled stopping power.
Large 200 mm air filled tires with alloy core wheels and ABEC-9 bearings provide a smooth, stable ride.
